title: Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet

abstractEnglish: For every dimension d ≥ 3 and every spin $`S\in\{\frac12,1,\frac32,\ldots\}`$, we prove that the nearest-neighbor isotropic quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet has a translation-invariant, spontaneously magnetized equilibrium state at every sufficiently low positive temperature. The same state satisfies the KMS condition for the zero-field dynamics and has magnetization at least $`S/4`$. This resolves the low-temperature ordering problem in the spontaneous-magnetization formulation.
